Parse, query, calculate formulas, validate, edit, clean, analyze, and convert across PDF-1.7, Microsoft Excel (.xlsx), W3C XML 1.0, and JSON formats across any modern JavaScript runtime.

Engine Subsystems

Modular, zero-dependency architectures built for speed, safety, and specification fidelity.

EXCEL • CORE

Workbook & Sheet Hierarchy

Multi-worksheet management with dynamic 1-based coordinate mapping (A1 ↔ (col, row)), custom row heights, column widths, frozen panes, gridline controls, and merged cell ranges.

EXCEL • FORMULAS

Formula Expression Engine

Recursive-descent expression parser supporting arithmetic, comparisons, string concatenation, and built-in functions: SUM, AVERAGE, MIN, MAX, COUNT, IF, ROUND, and cross-sheet references.

EXCEL • STYLING

StyleSheet & Formatting

OpenXML styles manager for custom fonts, solid/pattern fills, multi-weight borders, horizontal/vertical alignments, text wrapping, and ISO number formats (currency, percentages, dates).

EXCEL • OPENXML

ZIP & OpenXML Serialization

In-memory ZIP archive engine with IEEE 802.3 CRC-32 checksums, Deflate compression, shared strings tables (SST), relationship maps, and XML builders for 100% compliant .xlsx files.

EXCEL • INTEROP

CSV, JSON & HTML Tables

Import and export data seamlessly. Load workbooks directly from CSV with auto-type casting, export to 2D arrays, structured JSON objects with header keys, or styled HTML <table> elements.

EXCEL • BUILDER

Declarative Report Builder

Fluent ExcelBuilder API for rapid reporting: branding headers, styled banner titles, auto-fitted table columns, zebra-striped data rows, and automated total calculation rows.

PDF • CORE

Lexer & Object Parser

Tokenizes arbitrary binary streams. Handles standard PDF objects: Dictionaries, Arrays, Indirect References (R), Hex Strings, Name objects, Booleans, and Real numbers.

PDF • STREAMS

Filter Decompression

Chained multi-stage decoders including FlateDecode, ASCIIHexDecode, ASCII85Decode, RunLengthDecode, and LZW with TIFF/PNG horizontal and vertical predictor inversion.

PDF • INDEXING

Cross-Reference Tables

Locates startxref from EOF, parses classic table sections, handles multi-generation free/in-use entries, and parses modern compressed Cross-Reference Streams.

PDF • FONTS

Typography & Metrics

Standard 14 PDF font metrics (Helvetica, Times, Courier, Symbol, ZapfDingbats) with character advance width tables, kerning, and automated line wrapping algorithms.

PDF • GRAPHICS

Vector Engine & Paths

Affine matrix transformation pipeline (scale, rotate, translate, skew). Constructs Bézier curves, straight paths, clipping paths, and fill/stroke operators.

PDF • SECURITY

Encryption & Metadata

Standard 40-bit and 128-bit encryption handlers, user/owner password authentication, permissions dictionaries, and full trailer /Info metadata serialization.

XML • DOM TREE

W3C DOM & Tokenizer

Full DOM Level 3 compliant node graph: XmlDocument, XmlElement, XmlText, XmlCData, XmlComment, and XmlProcessingInstruction with line/column diagnostic tracking.

XML • QUERIES

XPath & CSS Selectors

Query document nodes effortlessly via querySelector and querySelectorAll, or evaluate XPath 1.0 expressions including deep axis //tag, predicates [@attr="val"], and positional indexing.

XML • JSON BRIDGE

Bidirectional XML ↔ JSON

Seamless interoperability between XML documents and JavaScript objects. Automatic array aggregation, configurable attribute prefixes (@attr), automatic type coercion, and fluent programmatic XmlBuilder.

JSON • CONVERTERS

Multi-Format Data Converters

Bi-directional, zero-loss transformation between JSON and XML, CSV, YAML, NDJSON, Microsoft Excel (.xlsx), and styled PDF data reports with automatic header inference and delimiter auto-detection.

JSON • EDITORS

Path Editor & RFC 6902 Patch

Dot-notation & JSON Pointer path navigation (get, set, delete), full RFC 6902 JSON Patch engine (applyPatch, createPatch), object flattening/unflattening, key renaming, and deep merge.

JSON • VALIDATORS

Diagnostic Validator & JSON Schema

High-precision syntax validation with line/column pointers and visual code snippets. Complete JSON Schema Draft-07 validator supporting types, ranges, regex patterns, formats (email, uuid, uri, date), and required fields.

JSON • ANALYZERS

Structural Profiler & Schema Inferer

Profiles byte sizes (raw, formatted, gzipped estimate), total nodes, max depth, type distribution, and anomaly detection. Automatically synthesizes ready-to-use JSON Schema Draft-07 contracts from arbitrary datasets.

JSON • INSPECTORS

Diff Inspector & JSONPath Queries

Deep structural diffing comparing additions, removals, and value/type modifications across documents. JSONPath query engine evaluating deep descent $..price, wildcards, and filter expressions [?(@.active)].

JSON • CLEANERS

Sanitizer, Minifier & Auto-Repair

Auto-heals malformed JSON by stripping JS comments (//, /* */), fixing single quotes, quoting bare keys, and stripping trailing commas. Cleans nulls, empty strings/arrays, trims values, and normalizes key ordering.

Quickstart API Guide

Intuitive, fluent TypeScript/JavaScript APIs designed for seamless document workflows.

import { ExcelWorkbook, ExcelStyle } from './src/index.js';

// 1. Create a new workbook and worksheet
const wb = new ExcelWorkbook();
wb.properties.title = 'Q3 Financial Summary';
const ws = wb.addWorksheet('Revenue');

// 2. Configure column widths & headers
ws.setColumnWidth('A', 24);
ws.setColumnWidth('B', 16);
ws.setColumnWidth('C', 16);

const headerStyle = new ExcelStyle({
  font: { name: 'Arial', size: 11, bold: true, color: 'FFFFFF' },
  fill: { fgColor: '0055A5' },
  alignment: { horizontal: 'center' }
});

const header = ws.addRow(['Product', 'Units Sold', 'Unit Price', 'Total Revenue']);
[1, 2, 3, 4].forEach(c => header.getCell(c).setStyle(headerStyle));

// 3. Add data rows with formula references
ws.addRow(['DataFrog Core', 1200, 49.99, '=B2*C2']);
ws.addRow(['Excel Engine Pro', 850, 79.99, '=B3*C3']);
ws.addRow(['Total', '=SUM(B2:B3)', '', '=SUM(D2:D3)']);

// 4. Calculate formulas in-memory
wb.calculateAllFormulas();
console.log('Calculated total:', ws.getCell('D4').value);

// 5. Save as standard XLSX binary or export to CSV/JSON
const xlsxBytes = wb.save(); // Uint8Array
const csvString = ws.toCsv();
const jsonRows = ws.toJson();

// 6. Read back from XLSX bytes
const loadedWb = ExcelWorkbook.open(xlsxBytes);
const sheet = loadedWb.getWorksheet('Revenue');
console.log(sheet.getCell('A2').value); // 'DataFrog Core'
import { ExcelBuilder } from './src/index.js';

// Declarative report generation with styled titles and tables
const builder = new ExcelBuilder({
  title: 'Executive Operations Report',
  creator: 'DataFrog Analytics',
  themeColor: '0A58CA'
});

builder
  .sheet('Operations')
  .title('Operations Performance Summary', { subtitle: 'Generated Autumn 2026' })
  .table({
    headers: ['Department', 'Allocated Budget', 'Actual Spent', 'Variance'],
    rows: [
      ['Core Platform', 500000, 475000, 25000],
      ['Document Rendering', 280000, 265000, 15000],
      ['Infrastructure & Cloud', 190000, 205000, -15000]
    ],
    totalRow: true,
    totalLabels: ['Total', 'SUM', 'SUM', 'SUM']
  });

const reportBytes = builder.save(); // Serializes directly to Uint8Array
import { PdfDocumentBuilder, PdfDocument } from './src/index.js';

// 1. Build a structured PDF document
const builder = new PdfDocumentBuilder({ pageSize: 'A4', margins: 40 });

builder.addHeading('Quarterly Performance Report', 1);
builder.addParagraph('Generated directly with pure JavaScript engine.');

builder.addTable({
  headers: ['Metric', 'Q3 Actual', 'Target', 'Variance'],
  rows: [
    ['Total Ingestion', '1.24 GB', '1.00 GB', '+24%'],
    ['Processing Latency', '4.2 ms', '10.0 ms', '-58%'],
    ['Render Fidelity', '100%', '99.9%', '+0.1%']
  ]
});

// 2. Serialize to compliant binary Uint8Array
const pdfBytes = builder.save();

// 3. Re-open, inspect, and extract text
const doc = await PdfDocument.open(pdfBytes);
console.log(`Pages: ${doc.pageCount}`);
const text = doc.getPage(0).extractText();
console.log(text);
import { XmlParser, XmlBuilder, XmlConverter, XmlQuery, XmlValidator } from './src/index.js';

// 1. Parse XML into W3C DOM tree
const doc = XmlParser.parse(`<catalog name="Store"><item id="i1" inStock="true"><title>Notebook</title><price>29.99</price></item></catalog>`);

// 2. CSS & XPath queries
const item = doc.querySelector('#i1');
const title = item.querySelector('title').textContent; // 'Notebook'
const inStockItems = XmlQuery.evaluateXPath(doc, '//item[@inStock="true"]');

// 3. Bidirectional JSON conversion
const json = XmlConverter.toJson(doc);
const xmlStr = XmlConverter.fromJson(json, 'catalog', { indent: 2 });

// 4. Fluent XML Builder
const builder = new XmlBuilder('feed', { xmlns: 'http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom' });
builder
  .element('title', 'Tech Updates')
  .element('entry', { id: '1' })
    .element('summary', 'XML Engine Launched')
    .cdata('<p>Full W3C spec compliance.</p>');

console.log(builder.toString({ indent: 2 }));
import { JsonEngine, JsonConverter, JsonEditor, JsonValidator, JsonAnalyzer, JsonCleaner } from './src/index.js';

// 1. Lenient parse & auto-repair (handles single quotes, unquoted keys, comments & trailing commas)
const raw = `{ name: 'Quantum Processor', price: 899.95, /* in stock */ inStock: true, }`;
const data = JsonEngine.parse(raw, { lenient: true });

// 2. Multi-Format Data Converters (XML, CSV, YAML, NDJSON, Excel, PDF)
const xml = JsonEngine.toXml(data, 'product');
const csv = JsonEngine.toCsv([data]);
const yaml = JsonEngine.toYaml(data);
const xlsxBytes = JsonEngine.toExcel([data], { sheetName: 'Catalog' });
const pdfBytes = JsonEngine.toPdf([data], { title: 'Hardware Catalog' });

// 3. Path-based mutations & RFC 6902 JSON Patch
JsonEngine.set(data, 'specs.cores', 128);
const patch = JsonEngine.createPatch({ inStock: true }, { inStock: false, discount: 0.15 });
const updated = JsonEngine.applyPatch(data, patch);

// 4. Full JSON Schema Draft-07 Validation & Automatic Inference
const schema = JsonEngine.inferSchema(data);
const report = JsonEngine.validateSchema(data, schema);
console.log('Schema conforms:', report.valid);

// 5. Sanitizer, Sorting & Formatting
const sanitized = JsonEngine.clean(data, { stripNulls: true, sortKeys: true });
console.log(JsonEngine.format(sanitized, { indent: 2 }));

Architecture & Pipeline

Unified deterministic processing pipelines adhering strictly to international document standards.

01

Universal Lexing & Resilient Parsing

Parses raw bytes, OpenXML ZIP packages, W3C XML tokens, and JSON streams directly with zero external dependencies.

02

Object Graphs, DOM & AST Models

Constructs indirect PDF object maps, resolves spreadsheet relationships, maintains XML DOM trees, and indexes JSON paths.

03

Processing, Patching & Validation

Evaluates spreadsheet expressions, calculates typography, applies RFC 6902 patches, and enforces JSON Schema Draft-07 rules.

04

Compliant Binary & Multi-Format Output

Generates immutable binary PDF-1.7, standard Microsoft Excel (.xlsx), formatted W3C XML, and optimized JSON/CSV/YAML data.
